key_insight: A vision transformer with attention can classify narrow-band endoscopy images of laryngeal lesions as benign or malignant while also highlighting suspicious regions for explanation.
clinical_relevance: This could support earlier laryngeal cancer screening and reduce reliance on manual interpretation in endoscopy workflows.
method: Uses a transformer-based model to analyze NBI endoscopy images
Uses MedSAM segmentation to localize pathological areas for clinician review
evidence_signal: The abstract reports classification performance of F1 82.72% and accuracy 82.33% on the study evaluation.
watch_item: Performance and explainability need validation on larger, multi-center datasets before routine clinical use.
paper_title: Medical Imaging Fusing Vision Transformer: Laryngeal Cancer Screening with Explanation
